headline: Hubble Spots Galaxy With Sideways Rotating Center
instagramCaption:
The Hubble Space Telescope has identified a galaxy with an unusual rotational orientation.

Observations reveal that the center of this specific galaxy rotates sideways relative to its outer regions. This structural anomaly challenges standard models of galactic formation and dynamics.

Understanding such bizarre configurations helps astronomers refine theories about how galaxies evolve over time.
